gate.tagline: Leave your voice for a stranger. Up to sixty seconds. No name.
gate.desktopHint: Works best in Chrome or Safari. Your microphone is only used while you record.

prompt.current: what's the in-between you're in right now?

helpline.struggling: Struggling right now? <link>Find a helpline in your country</link>.
helpline.danger: In immediate danger? Call 112 (EU) or your local emergency number.

mode.title: WHO IS IT FOR?
mode.confideBody: About you. This week's question, or anything you're carrying.
mode.encourageTitle: LEAVE A NOTE FOR A STRANGER
mode.encourageBody: For whoever hears it next. Say what you'd have wanted to hear.
mode.freeNote: Free to talk about anything. The weekly question is only a starting point.
mode.medicalNote: Please don't give medical advice: say how it felt, not what to take.

record.hint: Your voice draws the line. When it reaches the edge, you're done.
record.hintDesktop: Your voice draws the line. When it reaches the edge of the screen, you're done.
record.staysHere: Nothing leaves your phone until you choose to share it.
record.staysHereDesktop: Space bar to start and stop · Nothing leaves your computer until you choose to share it.
record.staysHereDesktop__TODO: TODO(copy) the design said "Space bar to stop"; the space bar now also starts (decisions log)
record.tooShort: Too short to share: at least 5 seconds. Start over and say a little more.

micBlocked.title: We can't reach your microphone.
micBlocked.body: If you opened this from Instagram or TikTok, open it in Safari or Chrome instead: tap the ••• menu, then 'Open in browser'. Otherwise, allow the microphone in your browser settings and try again.

share.title: WHAT NOW?
share.letGoBody: Keep it to yourself. Nothing is uploaded or saved. Saying it was the point.
share.shareBody: Put it on the line for a stranger to hear, without your name.
share.consentTitle: Before it goes on the line
share.consentStore: Store and process my note. It may say things about my health or my life.
share.consentPublish: Share it without my name on social posts, the newsletter and The Line library, a page on histrnger.com where anyone, anywhere, can listen to notes left by strangers, sorted by theme. It stays there until I delete it with my private link.
share.consentEdit: Let Strnger edit, translate and re-voice it.
share.voiceOwn: My own voice. People who know you may recognise it. Once shared, others could record it.
share.voiceNarrator: A narrator's voice. Your words, read by someone else.
share.reviewed: A person reviews every note before it's shared.
share.error_bot_check: We couldn't check that you're a person. Please try again.
share.error_rate_limited: You've left 3 notes today, the most for one day. Come back tomorrow.
share.error_too_short: This recording is too short to share. Leave a new one of at least 5 seconds.
share.error_recording: This recording can't be sent. Please leave a new one.
share.error_other: Something went wrong and your note wasn't sent. Please try again.

ticket.title: IT'S ON THE LINE.
ticket.reviewed: A person reviews every note before it's shared.
ticket.afterThreeDays: After that, it may appear on social posts, in the newsletter and in the library.
ticket.afterAsap: Once it's reviewed, it may appear on social posts, in the newsletter and in the library.
ticket.linkNote: The only way to delete your note, before or after it's shared. We can't send it again: we don't know who you are.

letGo.gone: It's gone. You said it out loud, and that counts.

deletion.title: YOUR NOTE
deletion.waiting: Your note is waiting to be reviewed. It hasn't been shared.
deletion.deleted: This note has been deleted. Its recording is gone.
deletion.notFound: We can't find a note for this link. Check that you copied all of it.
deletion.explain: You can delete it at any time, before or after it's shared. Deleting is final.
deletion.confirm: Delete it for good? This can't be undone.
deletion.done: Deleted. Your note is gone for good.
deletion.error: Something went wrong and your note wasn't deleted. Please try again.
